name: VM/project/configuration join
sql: SELECT v.vm_id,v.name,p.name AS project,c.vcpu,c.ram_gb,v.state FROM virtual_machine v JOIN project p USING(project_id) JOIN vm_configuration c USING(vm_configuration_id) ORDER BY v.vm_id LIMIT 5

name: VM counts by state
sql: SELECT state,count(*)::int AS vm_count FROM virtual_machine GROUP BY state ORDER BY state

name: Host capacity integrity
sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS violations FROM cloud_host WHERE allocated_cpu<0 OR allocated_cpu>total_cpu OR allocated_ram_gb<0 OR allocated_ram_gb>total_ram_gb

name: Request status integrity
sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS violations FROM vm_request WHERE (status='PENDING' AND (vm_id IS NOT NULL OR reviewed_at IS NOT NULL)) OR (status='APPROVED' AND vm_id IS NULL)

name: Projects without VMs
sql: SELECT project_id,name FROM project p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM virtual_machine v WHERE v.project_id=p.project_id)

name: UPDATE
sql: UPDATE review_crud_demo SET vcpu=4 WHERE id=1 RETURNING *

name: DELETE
sql: DELETE FROM review_crud_demo WHERE id=1 RETURNING *
